title: Orders API latency spike
claims: Orders API p95 latency increased on September 16.
The service was running v2.8.1 during the incident.
content: Incident INC-1042 records a latency spike affecting orders-api. The root cause was not confirmed at incident time.

title: Orders API v2.8.1 deployment
claims: orders-api v2.8.1 was deployed at 18:10 UTC on September 15.
content: Deployment DEP-882 completed for orders-api version v2.8.1. No causal link to a later incident is asserted.

title: May Orders API latency incident
claims: A prior orders-api latency incident was caused by database connection saturation during a schema migration.
content: Postmortem PM-211 describes historical latency in orders-api caused by database connection saturation during a schema migration.

title: Latency response guide
claims: Restart the service when latency remains high.
content: Old troubleshooting guidance for persistent latency.

title: Dependency failure response
claims: Do not restart Service A during dependency failures; check dependency health first.
content: Updated troubleshooting guidance for dependency failures.
